# EchoTools

> The software layer for humans and agents.

EchoTools is an independent SaaS discovery directory. This file summarizes the catalog
for LLMs and AI agents. Full details for each tool live at `/tools/<slug>`.

## Human layer (software for people)

Tools for marketing, CRM, productivity, design, finance, hosting, and AI assistance.

- `/tools/hubspot` — CRM & marketing hub
- `/tools/semrush` — SEO suite
- `/tools/mailerlite` — email marketing
- `/tools/notion` — notes & docs
- `/tools/webflow` — web design & hosting
- `/tools/vercel` — frontend deployment
- `/tools/chatgpt` — AI assistant
- ... see `/tools` for the full catalog.

## Agent layer (software for AI agents)

Frameworks, memory, scraping, vector data, browser agents, and observability.

- `/tools/apify` — web scraping & automation
- `/tools/firecrawl` — web scraping for AI
- `/tools/supabase` — Postgres backend
- `/tools/langchain` — agent framework
- ... see `/tools` for the full catalog.

## API summary

- `GET /tools` — full catalog page
- `GET /tools/<slug>` — individual tool page
- `GET /categories/<slug>` — category landing pages
- `GET /sitemap.xml` — sitemap

## Editorial policy

- Every tool is ranked on usefulness alone.
- Pricing, features, and alternatives are verified and dated on each tool page.
